extras: Keyless SHA-256 integrity only (no signatures or secrets); a verified seal proves the payload is intact, not that it is true or safe. Separate from the browser Lens at knobe.org/lens. Notes in the older KNOBE.AI 0.1 HTML format are labelled Not KNOBE v1 and excluded from Recognition, portfolios, the world, and lineage.
problem: Obsidian provides no way to verify, inspect, or create the hash-sealed KNOBE Protocol v1 knowledge objects that carry a document's interpretive context inside the file.

relations.evidence: Faithful port of the reference lens.py (KnobeOne/knobe-protocol 6132595)

summary: Obsidian plugin to verify, inspect, and seal KNOBE Protocol v1 knowledge objects (hash-sealed Markdown notes) in your vault.
